newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo companies sack 9,462 workers in October.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo companies sack 9,462 workers in October.

text.p: Private companies located in Sao Paulo state laid off 9,462 employees in October, compared with 5,470 workers in September, Sao Paulo State Industries Federation (Fiesp) said Monday in a statement.
Twenty-two out of the 46 sectors included in the survey sacked personnel in the period. Twenty hired new people and four maintained their staff unchanged, it said.
So far this year, Sao Paulo industries have laid off 160,149 workers or 7.48 percent of the Sao Paulo's industrial workforce, the statement said.
In the last 12 months, Sao Paulo firms have sacked 215,223 workers, or 9.73 percent of Sao Paulo's industrial workforce, it said.
